scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jarvis/domain run build && pnpm --filter @jarvis/queue run build && tsc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @jarvis/domain run build && pnpm --filter @jarvis/queue run build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @jarvis/domain run build && pnpm --filter @jarvis/queue run build && pnpm run build && node --test src/*.test.mjs test/*.integration.test.mjs
